title: Padel Sustain T Shirt
body_html:
No planet B. Built to move.

Padel is quick, reactive and relentless. The Off White Sustain Padel T Shirt is designed to move naturally through every rally, combining a clean athletic fit with lightweight technical performance.

How the fit works

Cut for a clean athletic fit with full freedom of movement. The fabric stretches naturally with the body, so every sprint, swing and recovery feels effortless. A considered size range makes it easy to find your fit, and if it isn’t right, we’ll remake it.

Fabric & performance

Lightweight technical performance fabric keeps you comfortable through long sessions. Breathable construction and moisture-wicking fibres help manage sweat, while the quick-dry finish keeps the tee feeling fresh as the intensity rises.

Design & colour story

Quiet on the front, with a Padel and Planet graphic on the back. The Off White colour keeps the look clean, calm and versatile, while the Sustain name reflects the idea behind the piece: performance and responsibility should move together.

Made to order, made responsibly

No planet B. That’s why every Padel Mentality tee is made to order, with production starting only when you place your order. We make only what players actually want, helping reduce excess stock and unnecessary waste. Your tee ships in around 10 days, with a free remake if your size isn’t right.
